data.description:
Position overview

The Senior Project Manager owns operations execution and project management for the Palestine sub-team in coordination with Avaaz. This is a senior, hands-on delivery role: you will keep project workstreams on track, build the systems and reporting that give leadership visibility, ensure risk and security protocols are implemented, and turn strategy into reliable operational execution under real constraints.

You will coordinate and hold accountability across project owners rather than managing a team of direct reports. You are the person who makes sure deadlines are clear, blockers surface early, and work does not fall through the cracks. You report to the Thiqa project lead and work closely with project owners, Avaaz operations, HR and Finance teams, and partners on the ground.

Although the team works remotely most of the time, it is strongly preferred for this position to be in the West Bank, or that the candidate  has a deep understanding of Palestine and who has worked there.
data.key_responsibilities:
Project management and delivery

  • Serve as the central coordination point for the team, ensuring deadlines, deliverables, and priorities are clear, owned, and met across all project streams.
  • Track and manage progress across concurrent projects, keeping a single reliable source of truth for status, owners, and next steps.
  • Run the cadence: prepare and lead key project meetings, and follow up with each owner afterwards so momentum and deadlines hold.
  • Prepare and share weekly project dashboards summarising status, blockers, risks, and next steps for leadership.
  • Support and coordinate project owners rather than replacing them, stepping in directly only when a gap would otherwise stall delivery.
  • Ensure security protocols are followed.
  • Support donor cultivation and fundraising efforts
  • Coordinate cross-team and cross-organisational collaboration, including with partners and Avaaz departments.

Performance tracking and reporting

  • Track operational KPIs such as throughput and survey progress, and keep them visible.
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives leadership real-time visibility into operational health.
  • Use data to flag risks early and drive evidence-based decisions on prioritisation and resourcing.

Process and systems

  • Design and document lightweight standard operating procedures (SOPs) that fit how the team actually works, so quality and consistency hold as the team scales.
  • Analyse workflows to remove friction, cut cycle times, and reduce operational cost.
  • Select and set up practical tooling to support project tracking and reduce manual work, matched to the team's context and adoption capacity.

Event and operational support

  • Support the operational delivery of team events and gatherings, in a high-security context.
  • Anticipate operational risk, build contingency plans, and pivot quickly when conditions change.

What success looks like

Projects run on time with clear ownership; leadership has an accurate, current view of status and risk at any moment; blockers are caught early rather than at the deadline; and the team operates on systems that hold up under pace and pressure. 

Why this role matters to leadership
For the director of this project, this role acts as a force multiplier rather than another layer to manage. By owning the operational cadence, tracking, and follow-through, the Project Manager frees leadership from day-to-day delivery mechanics and lets them focus on strategy, external relationships, and high-stakes decisions. Leadership gains a trusted second set of eyes across every workstream, someone who translates direction into action, surfaces risk before it becomes a crisis, and ensures accountability holds even without formal authority over project owners. In a high-constraint, high-security environment, this means the project lead can trust that operations are being actively managed and de-risked, even when they are not in the room.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
The ideal candidate has at least five years of experience in project management and operations delivery, ideally within a fast-paced, mission-driven, or international organisation. They have owned delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams and are comfortable holding others accountable without formal authority over them.
  • Proven project management. Track record of keeping complex, multi-stream projects on time, with the judgement to prioritise under pressure.
  • Systems and process builder. Has designed SOPs, reporting, and workflows that people actually adopt, and can right-size them to the team rather than over-engineering.
  • Operates under constraint. Stays composed and keeps delivery moving in a high-stakes, unpredictable environment; strong on contingency and rapid re-planning.
  • Accountability with empathy. Skilled at follow-up and delegation tracking; holds the line on deadlines while navigating people and context with emotional intelligence.
  • Communication. Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Arabic.
  • Tech-comfortable. Fluent in project-tracking and collaboration tools; experience with Asana, Slack, and Google Suite is a plus but not required.
data.title: Senior Project Manager (Palestine)

data.benefits:
Location. Avaaz is a remote organization, with most of our work done over email, Google Docs, Slack, and Zoom. This role works on US Eastern Time, and candidates based in the Virginia / Washington, DC area are preferred.

Salary. We set salaries by experience and local cost of living, in line with leading international NGOs.
  • US candidates: $93,636 - $104,367
Benefits include:
  • 5 weeks paid vacation per year
  • 10 paid holidays per year
  • Up to US$3,000 per year for training and development
  • Up to US$1,500 per year for language development
  • Out-of-home workspace rental
data.description:
Avaaz is seeking an exceptionally organised, proactive, and tech-savvy Senior Operations Officer to serve as a key operational partner to our Chief Operating Officer (COO). The COO oversees Finance, People & Culture, Compliance, and Operations Support across our US and UK entities, and serves as Secretary of the Board.

This is a hands-on executive support role that combines day-to-day coordination with complex project coordination and operational improvement. You'll see both the big picture and the details: you'll anticipate what needs to happen next, connect the dots across teams, and make sure commitments turn into action. You'll also help us work smarter, using tools like Asana, Notion, and AI to connect our meetings, decisions, projects, and knowledge into integrated workflows.

This position reports to an Operations Director and works closely with the COO.
data.key_responsibilities:
Executive partnership

  • Serve as a trusted operational partner to the COO, anticipating needs, managing competing priorities, protecting her time and attention, and recommending practical next steps.
  • Manage the COO's calendar, inbox, travel, expenses, and daily workflows with excellent judgment and discretion.
  • Prepare concise, accurate briefings, decision summaries, and executive and board materials.
  • Handle sensitive HR, legal, financial, and board information with discretion, and raise compliance risks promptly with the appropriate colleagues.

Project coordination and operating rhythm

  • Coordinate the COO's operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, Operations team check-ins, planning cycles, and board preparation. Ensure each meeting has a clear agenda, notes, decisions, and assigned actions.
  • Track complex, interconnected conversations and workstreams, maintaining context on decisions, commitments, dependencies, and follow-ups. Proactively identify what's stuck, what needs to happen next, and what requires leadership attention.
  • Coordinate complex, cross-functional initiatives across Finance, People & Culture, Compliance, and Operations Support, proactively following up with stakeholders, resolving routine bottlenecks, and keeping work moving. Independently manage defined projects from planning through delivery.

AI-enabled systems and process improvement

  • Help design, implement, and maintain integrated workflows using Asana, Notion, Slack, and AI, connecting meetings, decisions, project tracking, and follow-up to improve visibility, reduce duplication, and ensure commitments don't fall through the cracks.
  • Use AI and automation thoughtfully to reduce manual work, while maintaining safeguards for confidentiality, accuracy, and human judgment.
  • Help colleagues adopt agreed systems and build consistent ways of working.
data.skills_knowledge_expertise:
You should apply if you believe you have the skills and experience to succeed in this role, even if you don't meet every requirement below.
  • Relevant experience. You have 5+ years in executive support, operations, or project coordination, ideally supporting senior leaders in a complex, fast-moving environment.
  • Exceptional organization and follow-through. You keep track of multiple priorities and commitments without losing the details, and you reliably turn discussions into action.
  • Curiosity and initiative. You enjoy solving problems, questioning inefficient processes, experimenting with better approaches, and taking ownership without waiting to be asked.
  • Excellent judgment and adaptability. You quickly make sense of complex or ambiguous situations, anticipate needs, identify what matters most, and know when to act independently or escalate.
  • Project delivery. You can manage defined projects, coordinate stakeholders without relying on formal authority, and keep work moving as priorities shift.
  • AI and systems fluency. You already use AI in your daily work. You're confident with Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, and Notion, and you enjoy helping others get the most out of them.
  • Clear communication and synthesis. You can follow complex discussions and produce concise notes, briefings, and updates that help others act.
  • Discretion and a hands-on mindset. You handle sensitive information responsibly, take pride in helping others succeed behind the scenes, and are equally comfortable with detailed administration and higher-level coordination.
  • Commitment to our mission. You care about global justice, citizen empowerment, and social change.
  • Excellent English. Strong written and spoken English is required.
data.title: Senior Operations Officer (Executive Support, Project Coordination & Systems Integration)
